scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/contracts && concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/contracts && npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
